approach.guide: one deterministic local 3D kitchen and 12 beat-linked guide segments, built only after the plan and resource list are validated
approach.denoisingStrengthEvidence: starting value from a separate guide test recorded in kit/docs/wan2gp.md; not verified for crochet

seedPolicy.perBeat: base + step * beatIndex, zero-based; fixed before any test

proofGate.tailPolicy: guide ends on a settled clean plate; trim the 0.1625 s model overrun only after motion QA confirms the contact is complete
expandOnlyIf: all solid surfaces in the sampled frames read as crochet at phone size
the stitch scale stays stable from preparation through contact and result
the sponge stays in contact and the visible action includes soap, scrub, rinse and rack placement
the guide layout, palette and light remain stable
no P0/P1 finding remains in the hook review

runBoundary.nextGate: creator validates revision 02 and the resource plan; then GPU availability and explicit authorization are checked before any guide or Wan2GP render

replicability.reasonIncomplete: guide and native GUV settings are deliberately not materialized before creator validation and the render boundary
